full_name: Evan P. Economo | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2021–2022 Biological Sciences Mary I. Bunting Institute Fellow Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology Graduate University (Japan)
bio: Evan P. Economo is a professor at the Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology, where he leads the Biodiversity and Biocomplexity Unit. His research group integrates field, lab, and quantitative approaches to understand the processes generating and maintaining biodiversity.
